hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: Count the frequency of each unique value in the linked list.

hints.title: Key Observation
hints.text: Use a hash table or dictionary to tally frequencies during a single traversal.

hints.title: Algorithmic Steps
hints.text: Construct a new linked list where each node contains the count of one unique element.

hints.title: Implementation

variables: n: number of nodes in list
u: number of unique values in list
complexity.notes: Hash map tallies node frequencies, then creates u result nodes.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Counting frequencies without a hash map requires repeated traversals O(n^2).
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(u) extra space for frequency dictionary and result list.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Aggregate frequencies in linear time and emit a new linked list.
